accounting.costs: Recorded per-task mean cost per counted try, rounded. Lower-bound flags are preserved.
accounting.tokens: Reported input includes cached input; cached input is a subset. Token totals are recorded per task.
accounting.ratios: Sealed readout ratios and bootstrap intervals, not recalculated from rounded per-task costs.
accounting.quality: Reward first, then verifier tests passed. Cost ratios use the recorded equal-score cohort, including the disclosed ungraded Pro A row. Up to three counted tries per lane when behind.

evidence.contents: Recorded per-task outcomes, attempts, usage totals and costs for the four sealed readouts.
